Resolves #21785

`gantt/taskEditor`, `gantt/taskColumns` and `scheduler/eventEditor` now end their header toolbars with the `ThemeSwitcher`, as `gantt/basic` does. All three merged after the planning rollout (#21755), so until now a visitor could change their theme only through `?theme=`. `PlanningThemeSwitcher.spec.mjs` lists the three paths.

Evidence: L3 (headless Chromium e2e at 390 × 844 and 1440 × 900, frames) → L3 required (a rendered control). Residual: none.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/e2e/timeline/PlanningThemeSwitcher.spec.mjs` › "gantt/taskEditor keeps every toolbar control and ThemeSwitcher reachable without horizontal overflow at 390 × 844 and 1440 × 900", and the same test for `gantt/taskColumns` and `scheduler/eventEditor` |
| AC-2 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/e2e/gantt/TaskEditorNL.spec.mjs` and `test/playwright/e2e/gantt/TaskColumnsNL.spec.mjs`, unchanged, and `test/playwright/e2e/scheduler/EventEditor.spec.mjs`, whose Tab count now starts at the switcher (Deltas) |
| AC-3 | Outside CI: the frames below |

## Deltas from ticket

- `scheduler/eventEditor`'s spec reached the first appointment with two Tabs from the top of the page. The switcher is the first Tab stop now, so CI failed at `f93354ca86`. The two Tabs now start from the switcher, then pass the grid's header button and reach the same appointment (`6ec4a3957b`, `46f69d96c3`).
- *Retracted:* `6ec4a3957b` and an earlier version of this body blamed a macOS/Linux difference in Tab order. A probe showed Tab stops on buttons in macOS Chromium too. The Mac run that seemed to pass never ran this spec, because zsh passed its path with a trailing space as one argument.
